Good Vietnamese Food Experience
Nov 2013 • Family
We walked to the restaurant from our hotel in central Ho Chi Minh City (still known as Saigon). A large open air restaurant, we thought it might be a bit hot when we stopped to make reservations midday. At night it was perfect. 
The menu went on for pages, almost daunting. The varied noodle soups (not just pho) were great. As were the rolled rice pancake dinners. We all ate different things and shared. It all was terrific. We had beer so can't comment on the wines.
And the prices were great. Many families and many locals.

refreshingly clean with great service
Nov 2013
In total we had 3 separate nights over 12 nights spent in District 1. we thoroughly enjoyed the meals (morning glory, chicken curry and spring rolls to name a few) and quickly made friends with the young and enthusiastic staff.

The staff were charming, friendly and attentive with good English. we had a lot of fun singing both western and vietnamese songs. We even had the shy ones and a chef come and sing.

In fact we asked if any of the staff or managers would like to act as a guide, if we or friends were planning a visit to Saigon because their English and ability to communicate was so good.

The only feedback about the menu would be to include a little more local cuisine however what we ordered was tasty and good.

My cousin just dropped me an email saying his last night ended on a high in part because of the lovely dinner we had at coSigon.

reviews.review_text:
Ab K
Grays Thurrock, United Kingdom54 contributions
0
Over Priced, Poor Service, No customer Care.
Nov 2013 • Couples
We noticed the restaurant offered live music and free desert so my wife and I thought we would give it a try.
We were disappointed to find out that there was no live music as advertised and because of the lack of traditional Vietnamese food we opted for one of the 5 steak dishes on on the menu.
The staff speak very little English which was not so much of a problem as we just pointed at the photo of a delicious looking steak with fries and vegetables.

When the meals arrived we I noticed both steaks were tiny and covered in a brown sauce which was not on the photo or the description, also we did not get any fries.

They refused to accept they had got it wrong and insisted that was what we ordered.
We ate the meal anyway, the steak was like leather ( the table next to us also complained about theirs) and the vegetables were uncooked. (not al dente...UNCOOKED).

The so called free desert was a thin slice of water melon !!!

When we received the bill I saw a charge for 6000 VND when I queried it I was told it was a charge for Napkins !!!!!

THIS MUST BE THE ONLY RESTAURANT IN THE WORLD THAT CHARGES IT'S CUSTOMERS FOR NAPKINS !!!!!
Take my advice stay away from this place. Try the restaurant directly opposite. it has wooden tables and chairs, no doors and looks like a small warehouse but the food is authentic, delicious and half the price.
